    Path bases of represented string projectives #

    For a displayed vertex of a string presentation, the nontrivial surviving paths ending at that vertex split uniquely according to their final quiver arrow. This file packages that path partition as the direct sum of the represented string-arrow modules inside the corresponding canonical projective.
